description: Lists every connected Threads account of this member with the settings of the MindThread bulk settings sheet (run mode, auto-posting, review before publish, posting times, audience time zone, random schedule, library recycling, cold start, content language, AI quality, auto-reply and reply limits) and status chips (expired authorization, repeated publish failures, skipped nightly refill). Up to 100 accounts per page, with limit and cursor for more. columns describes each setting (type, allowed values, which ones are sensitive) and rules_url links to the field rules page. Applies when the user wants to see or compare settings across many accounts. 繁中：列出所有帳號的總表設定與狀態標籤。
name: list_account_settings
title: List account settings (bulk)
